subject: Procurement & billing path — post-call checklist and trial conversion plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme-retail.com>, Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: procurement checklist & trial conversion plan

Hi Alicia / Ivan —

Thanks again for your time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on procurement and the commercial path for the trial -> paid conversion.

Call recap (short):
- Trial scope: APAC catalog search + checkout integration (100k tokens/month mid-trial target).
- Success criteria: 1) latency under 200ms p95; 2) feature parity on the search rerank integration; 3) integration smoke tests pass across staging and prod-like data.
- Trial length: 30 days from activation.

Procurement / commercial questions we flagged on the call:
- Preferred payment method: PO (invoice, net30) vs corporate card — you mentioned procurement prefers PO for >$10k.
- Marketplace interest: any appetite to procure via AWS Marketplace (consolidated billing) vs direct SOW + invoice?
- Billing start: do you want billing to start on the activation date, or once success criteria & threshold are met (we can set a target start date instead)?

Suggested immediate next steps:
1) If PO: please share billing contact and billing address so I can surface to our finance team and draft an invoice template.
2) If marketplace preferred: we’ll share step-by-step procurement link and listing details (takes ~3–5 business days to confirm).
3) I’ll attach SOC 2 summary, DPA, and a short SOW for your procurement/legal to review.
4) Proposed billing start: 2026-04-01 contingent on trial activation and meeting the usage threshold we agreed (see proposal below).

Proposed trial-to-paid threshold (we can adjust):
- Sustained daily usage >= 1,000 inference units for 7 consecutive days OR all three success criteria met and sign-off.

I’ve looped in Marcus (CS lead) who will run onboarding if we get a PO confirmation. Let me know your preference for PO vs card vs marketplace and I’ll get the paperwork started.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-1212
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Recap: procurement checklist & trial conversion plan

Thanks Jasmine — helpful summary. A few notes from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement prefers PO for any commitment >$10k; otherwise we can use a corporate card for initial smaller pilots.
- Timeline: legal needs the SOC 2 report and DPA to complete a standard review (usually 3–5 business days once we have those docs).
- Marketplace: we are open to AWS Marketplace if it keeps billing on our consolidated invoice, but need to confirm with our cloud team.

Two quick questions: 
1) If we go PO, can you confirm how Redwood issues invoices (billing contact + billing address + required PO fields)?
2) For the billing start — we’d like billing to align with either activation or 'conversion' (i.e., when success criteria are met). Is it possible to set an agreed start date that can be moved earlier if conversion happens sooner?

Cc’ing Ivan (engineering lead) so he can weigh in on integration acceptance criteria and onboarding windows.

Thanks — I’ll share procurement contact details once I confirm with finance.

Best,
Alicia Torres
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Retail

Subject: Re: Recap: procurement checklist & trial conversion plan

Hi Alicia — great, thanks for the clarity. Attaching the SOC 2 summary, our DPA, and a short SOW focused on the trial scope so legal can start their review.

Answers inline: 
- Invoices / PO process:
  - If you submit a PO referencing deal RDW-5823 we can issue invoices net30 to the billing contact you provide.
  - Required PO fields: billing company name, billing address, PO number, payment terms (we accept net30), and billing email.
  - If you prefer card: we can accept for the pilot and migrate to PO invoicing on conversion.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace. If you purchase there billing is consolidated with your AWS bill; note that the contract terms and marketplace fees may differ slightly (we’ll share the marketplace SKU).
- Billing start date: we can set a target start date (proposed 2026-04-01). If you hit conversion criteria earlier we’ll accept a signed confirmation email to start billing earlier.

Proposed firm success criteria for conversion (to lock to billing):
1) Integration smoke tests green for search + checkout in staging (Ivan sign-off).
2) Performance: p95 latency < 200ms for search queries on the dataset samples you shared.
3) Usage: sustained >= 1,000 inference units/day for 7 consecutive days OR explicit product sign-off.

Attachments included:
- redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)
- redwood-dpa.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
- redwood-sow-acme-v1.pdf (PDF, 32KB)
- procurement-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-5823) and a DocuSign link for a short ordering SOW: https://app.docusign.com/link/EXAMPLE-DocuSign-12345

Marcus will reach out to schedule the onboarding slot once procurement confirms PO or card.

Let me know if you want us to draft the invoice template now — happy to do so and send to your billing contact.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
